topic: reset a forgotten Windows login password
core_question: I forgot my Windows password, how do I get back into my computer? (secondary: How do I see the wifi password for a network my Windows laptop is already connected to?)
answer_summary: If signing in with a Microsoft account, use the 'I forgot my password' link on the sign-in screen to reset it online; local accounts need a previously created password reset disk.; after the topic shift: Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks (or Control Panel's Network Sharing Center), open the network's Wireless Properties, Security tab, and check 'Show characters'.
persona: tired and blunt; texting quickly with typos here and there
